deals.name: The Waverly
deals.deal: Daily happy hour 11am-6pm: upstairs $7 house wines, downstairs $5 house wines. Beachfront spot with specials. Sushi available all day.

deals.name: Magnolia on the Bay
deals.deal: Tue-Fri 2-5pm, Sat-Sun 12-5pm (closed Mon): $5 off house wines by the glass, featured martinis $10, $4 off call cocktails/mimosas, $3 off craft drafts; Bay Bar specials on small plates. Available at bar & Bay View Garden.

deals.name: Beachcomber Trading Post Restaurant
deals.deal: Daily happy hour ~4:30-7:30pm with appetizers on the happy hour menu and drink specials. Popular for fresh food and specials.

deals.name: Lock 'N Key Restaurant
deals.deal: Daily happy hour noon-5pm (or similar long window). Drink and food specials advertised; one of the longer happy hours in the area.

deals.name: SandBar Tiki & Grille
deals.deal: Daily happy hour at the bar 11am-6pm (or longer). Food and drink specials; fried grouper and other items popular.

deals.name: Octovino
deals.deal: Daily happy hour 3-6pm: $1 off 6oz/9oz wine pours and $1 off charcuterie. Tue Industry Night 20% off after 4pm; Wed first-round BOGO.

deals.name: Banyan House
deals.deal: Daily happy hour 3-6pm: $2 off cask wine and $10 bar bites.

deals.name: Prime
deals.deal: Daily happy hour 4-6pm: $2 off Cask Fresh draft wines plus additional happy hour food and drink specials.

deals.name: The End Zone
deals.deal: Mon-Fri 12-6pm happy hour: $1.75 domestic draft beer and $2.50 well liquor.

deals.name: Bogey's Sports Pub
deals.deal: Daily Happy Hour 2-6pm: $1 off select domestic drafts, house wines, and well drinks. Stacks with daily food specials (Burger Monday, Taco Tuesday, Wing Wednesday, Fish Friday, etc.).

shop.name: Gold Rush BBQ
shop.deal: Takeout BBQ meats by the pound (ribs, chicken, pork, brisket) + sides by pint/quart. Convenient takeout window; also delivery apps.

shop.name: Metro Diner Venice
shop.deal: Family Packs serving ~4: Fried Chicken & Waffles ~$44, Bissell Platter ~$39, etc. Order online, Uber Eats, DoorDash, or curbside.

shop.name: Texas Best Barbecue
shop.deal: Popular BBQ takeout; highly rated. Check for family packs or pound pricing on meats and sides.

shop.name: El Jalisco Englewood
shop.deal: Occasional $15 for $30 Mexican cuisine deals (dine-in or takeout; fajitas, tacos, enchiladas). Check current promos.

shop.name: Local grocery (Publix / Walmart area)
shop.deal: Weekly circulars with store sales, digital coupons, and family meal solutions (rotisserie, prepared foods, produce deals).
